note: Pre-registered 2026-10-17 BEFORE any run of scripts/rag_query_vs_direct.py. Twelve invented witness reports (not the six fixed incidents), written by one reader from the entry titles of the knowledge base, not from retrieval results. Each case lists the NEEDS a good knowledge-agent input must cover; a need is met when at least one passage in the final 8 carries one of its any_of entry ids. Ids FI-21..26, FL-27..33 and ST-27..32 are French translations of English entries and count as the same guidance. Expectations were not tuned after seeing results; if one proves wrong it is reported as a flaw of this file. Stopping rule: 12 cases, 3 runs of the query agent each, no extra runs.

cases.text: Wildfire on the ridge above our village. A strong wind is pushing it toward the houses and people are loading their cars.
Un feu de broussailles s'approche d'un lotissement. Beaucoup de fumée, et des personnes âgées sont dans les maisons.
The fire has been put out but embers are still glowing on the ground. Residents want to go back to their houses.
Nous habitons près de la forêt et voulons préparer la maison avant l'été. Que faut-il faire autour de la maison et que prévoir pour partir vite.
L'oued déborde, l'eau entre dans les rez-de-chaussée et les routes sont coupées. Des voitures sont emportées.

needs.need: do not drive or walk in water

cases.text: The water went down in our street. We came back: power lines are down, the basement is wet and the food in the fridge got warm.
La maison est restée inondée trois jours. Il y a de la moisissure et nous utilisons un groupe électrogène dans le garage.
The river is rising fast. Residents on the ground floor are not sure whether to switch off gas and electricity or to leave.
A residential building partly collapsed after an explosion. Neighbours want to go inside to look for people and there is a smell of gas.
Un immeuble de six étages penche après un séisme. La police se demande à quelle distance éloigner les gens.
Des morceaux de façade tombent sur le trottoir devant un immeuble abîmé. Des commerçants veulent rouvrir leurs boutiques.

needs.need: impact of the cordon, controlled access

cases.text: After the earthquake an inspector put a red sign on our apartment block. The residents want to get their belongings.
